Guidance & outlook: India's growth rate for FY26 was more than the 6.5% growth rate during the previous year, FY25.

During FY26, headline inflation remained below target due to declining food prices, while core inflation rose from average 3.5% between April '24 and February '25, to an average 4.1% between April ‘25 and February '26, due to increasing gold and silver price.

Based on the recommendations of the NRC, the Audit Committee, and the Board, the Members of the Company had approved payment of commission up to 1% of the net profits of the Company, as computed under Section 198 of the Companies Act, 2013, to the Non-Executive Directors for a period of five financial years-from FY 2023-24 to FY 2027-28.
Growth & demand: The Advanced Economies grew by 1.9% while Emerging Market and Developing Economies grew by 4.4%, on an average, during 2025.
